abstract: Twenty-four patients receiving post-operative radiotherapy for testicular tumours have been studied to assess the impact of treatment errors. Regular treatment verification radiographs were performed and compared with simulator planning radiographs. It was demonstrated that lymph nodes in the area most at risk, i.e., para-aortic nodes at L1 to L3 on the ipsilateral side, were inadequately irradiated on 10% of treatments, and that at least one lymph node miss was recorded in 12 of the 24 patients. These results are considered to be a minimum estimate. Mostly para-aortic fields 8.0 cm wide were used, but it was shown that the number of lymph-node misses could have been substantially reduced by using fields 9.0 cm wide, whilst the consequent increase in irradiated kidney volume was considered acceptable.
abstract_ja: 精巣腫瘍に対して術後放射線療法を受けた患者24例を対象に、治療エラーの影響を評価した。治療照合用の定期的な撮影を行い、シミュレーターによる計画撮影と比較した。最も危険性の高い領域である同側のL1〜L3の傍大動脈リンパ節は、治療の10%において照射が不十分であった。24例中12例では、少なくとも1個のリンパ節の照射漏れが記録された。これらの結果は最小限の推定値と考えられる。主に幅8.0cmの傍大動脈照射野が用いられたが、幅9.0cmの照射野を用いればリンパ節の照射漏れを大幅に減らせたことが示された。照射される腎臓の体積の増加は許容範囲と考えられた。
